title: OrangeTree: A Linear and Tree-based Time Series Forecasting Model Supporting Multiple Input and Output Lengths
abstract: arXiv:2611.31905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series forecasting (TSF) models suffer from a critical rigidity: the inability to handle Multiple Input and Output Lengths (MIOL) within a single architecture. Current workarounds, such as padding or autoregression, often incur computational redundancy or suffer from error accumulation. We propose OrangeTree, a linear and tree-based architecture that decouples model parameters from sequence lengths. It employs a Segment Tree Encoder and an Inverse Tree Decoder to translate multi-length input history into multi-length output predictions within a unified framework. Crucially, a Range Weighter and a Feature Fuser bridge these components, dynamically selecting and fusing relevant ranges into optimal contexts for forecasting. Experiments on six benchmarks confirm OrangeTree achieves the SOTA performance. translated_title: OrangeTree：一种支持多输入多输出长度的线性与树结构时间序列预测模型
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测（TSF）模型存在一个关键的僵化问题：单一架构无法处理多输入多输出长度。目前的变通方法，如填充或自回归，往往会带来计算冗余或误差累积问题。我们提出了OrangeTree，这是一种线性与树结构相结合的架构，将模型参数与序列长度解耦。它采用分段树编码器和逆树解码器，在统一框架内将多长度的输入历史转化为多长度的输出预测。至关重要的是，范围加权器和特征融合器衔接了这些组件，动态选择并融合相关范围以构建最优的预测上下文。在六个基准数据集上的实验证实，OrangeTree实现了SOTA性能。在MIOL设置中，它在没有明显精度下降或计算量大幅增加的情况下，达到了与固定长度模型相当的精度。
tldr: OrangeTree通过分段树编码器、逆树解码器以及范围加权与特征融合机制，提出了一种将模型参数与序列长度解耦的线性树结构架构，在统一框架内实现了多输入多输出长度的时间序列预测，并在六个基准上达到了SOTA性能。
en_tdlr: OrangeTree proposes a linear and tree-based architecture that decouples model parameters from sequence lengths, using a Segment Tree Encoder, an Inverse Tree Decoder, a Range Weighter, and a Feature Fuser to enable unified multiple input and output length time series forecasting, achieving SOTA performance on six benchmarks.
